scope: CGB-001 PPU timing, CPU-to-panel signal inventory, comparable Sharp HR-TFT signal semantics, rails, and bounded scan/inversion reconstruction.
rules: Nintendo raster and palette facts may be frozen, but rounded software-visible PPU timing is not an exact measurement of panel LP, SPS, CLS, or REVC edges.
The Nintendo CPU diagram establishes named CGB pins; comparable Sharp documents establish family signal vocabulary, not CGB edge phase or voltages.
The 5-bit palette to 6-line-per-channel mapping remains unresolved unless an exact CGB electrical trace or panel/controller specification is found.
CGB supply rails are board/panel supply facts and must not be assigned to individual RGB codes.
The pinned Gambatte receipt validates source frames and timebase only; it does not observe the physical LCD interface.
No passive-matrix DMG selection loss or spatial crosstalk may be transferred into the CGB active-matrix reconstruction.

items.title: Nintendo Game Boy Programming Manual, version 1.1
claimsUsed: CGB CPU diagram exposes LDR0-LDR5, LDG0-LDG5, LDB0-LDB5, DCK, SPL, LP, PS, SPS, CLS, MOD, and REVC adjacent to the LCD drive signal buffer
CGB palette RAM stores five bits per R, G, and B channel
the screen is 160 segments by 144 visible lines followed by 10 vertical-blank lines
the published rounded timing is 108.7 microseconds per line, 15.66 milliseconds visible, 1.09 milliseconds vertical blank, and 59.7 hertz
LY spans 0-153 and lines 144-153 are vertical blank
items.limits: The manual does not define RGB555-to-six-wire expansion, panel DCK count, LP/SPS/CLS phase, REVC waveform, VCOM, gamma voltages, or optical onset.

items.title: Nintendo Game Boy Color Repair Procedures
claimsUsed: the display is HR-TFT 160 by 144 by RGB dots with common and segment drivers built into the LCD
the DC/DC converter provides 5 V, -15 V, and +13.6 V, with the latter two identified for LCD operation
items.limits: The rails are supply-level observations, not per-code pixel voltage, gamma reference, VCOM amplitude, or polarity phase.

items.title: Sharp LQ035Q2DD55 delivery specification
claimsUsed: DCLK samples data; LP latches the source driver; SPL starts source sampling; SPS starts the gate driver; CLS clocks the gate driver; MOD controls the gate driver; PS is power save
the comparable HR-TFT interface uses six explicitly ordered LSB-to-MSB wires per color
the comparable module separates analog and digital source supplies, gate rails, VCOM, and multiple standard gray-scale voltages
items.limits: This 240 by 320 front-lit module is not the CGB panel. Its pinout, signal phase, scanning direction, voltage values, RGB mapping, and VCOM values are not transferred.

items.title: Sharp LZ9JG17B TFT-LCD timing-controller datasheet
claimsUsed: the Sharp controller family distinguishes source-driver LP/data outputs from gate-driver CLS/SPS/MODE outputs
REVC is described as a preparatory signal for common-electrode drive
items.limits: The controller is not identified in CGB hardware and supplies no transferable CGB waveform or phase.

items.title: Game Boy and Game Boy Color external LCD/PGB signal mapping
claimsUsed: secondary connector mapping independently associates the named CGB LCD pins with an external display interface
items.limits: This is not Nintendo electrical documentation and does not establish exact waveform timing, voltage, or sixth-bit generation.

items.title: CGB-001 WS2 Gambatte source contract and exhaustive ROM receipt
claimsUsed: the selected source path presents exact RGB555 codes at 160 by 144 and 4194304/70224 hertz
all 32768 RGB555 codes pass through a deterministic ROM and the pinned core without ambiguity
items.limits: Emulator output does not identify physical panel signal timing, bus expansion, inversion, or optical response.

items.title: Exact CGB Sharp panel/controller specification gap
items.result: No exact CGB panel module number, panel timing specification, source-driver mapping, gamma ladder, or REVC/VCOM waveform is available in the accepted reference set.
items.limits: Absence from the accepted reference set does not prove that such a document or surviving trace cannot be found later.
